messages:
Sam (AE): FYI — AcmeCorp RFP just landed. They want API + Redwood Optimize + Console add-on as a single bundled offer. POC starts next Tue. Need a proposed rate card + requested discounts for a 12-month commit. Also they flagged the security questionnaire. Can sales ops + finance weigh in?
Carla (SolutionsEng): Re POC: we'll need sandbox access, 2 dedicated seats on Console, and Optimize eval with their 100k monthly token workload. I'll own infra setup.
Anya (AM): Acme's procurement hinted they expect ~20% off list for cross-product bundles. That's high; can we structure a stepped discount tied to commit? e.g., 10% at $100k ARR, 15% at $250k ARR, 20% at $500k ARR?
Luke (SalesOps): We prefer fixed tiers to avoid ad-hoc exceptions. Also need to know whether this is a reserved commit (monthly invoice) or consumption. If reserved commit, we can offer deeper discounts and guaranteed capacity.
Hiro (Finance): High-level constraints from rev ops: max promotional discount for bundled renewals is 18% on term deals without CFO sign-off. Anything above requires finance + legal approval. Also, commit should be recognized over the term; if they want break clauses, that changes treatment.
Sam (AE): They asked for a one-pager with pricing scenarios to share with procurement. Can someone draft two options: (A) reserved commit with 15% bundle discount at $150k ARR, (B) consumption + 10% volume rebate target.
Carla (SolutionsEng): Drafting technical POC runbook now. Security note: they want data segregation guarantees for logs and telemetry for the POC — we should pre-flag Console seats as RBAC-only and redact telemetry.
sec-team-bot: Sec questionnaire intake: https://intranet/redwood/sec-intake — please attach Acme questionnaire PDF. For POC, we can provide a limited SOC2 summary and a scoped security addendum.
Anya (AM): @sec-team-bot attaching their questionnaire in the thread (uploaded). Also procurement asked for sample SLA language and incident response times.
Luke (SalesOps): Putting together rate card drafts. Proposing these two bundle structures (quick sketch):
```
Option A (Reserved commit)
- API (text gen): $0.0008 per token (list)
- Optimize: $6,000 / month (list)
- Console add-on: $2,000 / month (list)
- Bundle discount: 15% off list with $150k annual commit

Option B (Consumption + rebate)
- API: $0.0010 per token (pay-as-you-go)
- Optimize: $7,500 / month (evaluation pricing)
- Console add-on: $2,500 / month
- Volume rebate: 10% rebate applied quarterly if monthly spend > $15k
```
Sam (AE): Good start. Can we make Option A clearer on capacity guarantees and canary fallbacks? Also they asked for a short special-term: no porting of models out during POC (for IP).
Carla (SolutionsEng): For the POC SLA, propose: 99% availability for the POC sandbox, dedicated support hours 9–5 PST, and one on-call rotation for production cutover. We'll include a signed data handling appendix that redacts telemetry after 30 days.
Hiro (Finance): If we push 15% on Option A at $150k, finance pre-approves up to 15% without CFO sign-off as long as it's a 12-month non-cancellable commit. Above 15% requires exec review. Also we need ACV broken down by product for bookkeeping.
Sam (AE): Procurement will likely push for a single-line item invoice. We should propose a consolidated billing view but have internal chargebacks separated.
Luke (SalesOps): Next step: I'll open a deal desk request. Need these attachments: 1) proposed rate card (we have the sketch), 2) POC runbook (Carla), 3) security questionnaire (attached), 4) suggested commercial terms (Anya/Hiro). Deal desk form linked: https://tools/deal-desk/new.
deal-bot: Deal desk ticket created: DD-2026-482. Link: https://tools/deal-desk/DD-2026-482. Assigned to Luke, Hiro.
sec-team-bot: Quick note — for the security Q, we can provide: SOC2 summary, encryption details, and a limited-data-handling addendum. Estimated turnaround: 3 business days after intake.
Anya (AM): I'll run procurement calls next Wed. Can we get an approval thread by EOD Monday so I can escalate if needed?
Carla (SolutionsEng): POC checklist ETA: EOD today. I'll include RBAC config and telemetry redaction steps.
Luke (SalesOps): Putting the DD ticket in review. Flagging 15% discount for Option A and 10% rebate for Option B. If the account wants a blended 20% we need exec sign-off.
Hiro (Finance): Noted. I've tentatively approved the 15% on reserve as long as contract is 12 months firm. I'll also pre-authorize a one-time pilot credit up to $10k to cover POC infra costs.
Sam (AE): Perfect. I'll update Acme with two options and set expectation: final commercial sign-off after deal-desk approval. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Carla (SolutionsEng): +1. I'll stand by for the POC kickoff details and will schedule infra prep for Monday.
Luke (SalesOps): Will post the DD-2026-482 approval link here when review is complete.
sec-team-bot: Security intake received. Questionnaire triage started.
Hiro (Finance): FYI — cc CFO for any approval >15%.
Sam (AE): Closing loop: I'll post the procurement meeting notes here after Wed call.
